_meta.description: Health care cost inputs for retirement years (data dictionary 5.1, healthcare line; M2 spec section 4 C). Before 65: an ACA marketplace benchmark premium less the premium tax credit. From 65: Medicare premiums plus a placeholder for a supplement and out-of-pocket costs. The engine reads these numbers only from here and from data/rules-registry.json.
_meta.status: PROPOSED PLACEHOLDERS. The benchmark premium and the from-65 supplement are not sourced yet (open question O3). Every value marked lookUp must be checked by Eli before release.

benchmarkSilverPremiumAnnualPerAdult.source: Placeholder equal to the tie-out convention (tests/tie-out-conventions.md item 10). The real figure is the second-lowest-cost silver plan for the person's age and county, from HealthCare.gov plan preview.

outOfPocketAnnual.source: Not modeled yet; deductibles and copays vary too much by plan.

before65.ageRating: Not modeled: the same benchmark is used at every age under 65. Real premiums rise with age under the 3:1 federal age curve.

partBStandardMonthly.note: Read from the rules registry, which carries the CMS figure.

partDBasePremiumAnnual.source: Placeholder. CMS publishes the Part D base beneficiary premium each year (2026 figure not fetched from this session).

supplementAndOutOfPocketAnnual.source: Placeholder covering a Medigap or Advantage premium and out-of-pocket costs. Combined with Part B this lands near the tie-out convention of 3,600 a year from 65.

medicaidExpansion.note: Which states expanded Medicaid decides whether income under 138% of the poverty line goes to Medicaid instead of a credit (strategy C2). Not sourced from this session (medicaid.gov and kff.org unreachable). Until it is, the engine treats every state as unknown and flags it.
